rows.text: Talanton's royal judges would only take out the Judgment Device when faced with the most enigmatic cases. The lion heads on the two sides of the device would each tightly clamp down on a piece of evidence — These could be a bloodstained dagger or a bottle of poisoned honey brew, and the scale would always tilt favorably towards the item that's more indicative of the truth. While some culprits can indeed create "perfect crimes," they tend to forget that the most reliable evidence will always remain in their hearts. Put the suspect's finger into the lion's mouth, and Talanton will show them how their denials are nothing before the lions' teeth.
